proof_readback: Periodic at-most-three cap is scoped to one positive distance on a rank-two discrete Euclidean lattice; zero-step layers are explicitly allowed.
The D=36 layer of x^2+xy+6y^2 has three opposite step pairs and exact odd girth 23; the cap and lower bound are not inferred from a census.
The ratio alpha/beta=(11+5sqrt(-3))/14 has norm one and trace11/7; nonintegrality of its rational trace excludes finite order.
Commensurability zO~O is equivalent to z in Q(omega) for nonzero z, and rotation commensurators are its unit-modulus elements. This is distinct from the six exact lattice units.
The conjugate norm-seven ideals sum to O: 3(alpha+beta)-2alpha beta=1. Infinite-order rotation therefore does not itself prove lattice/field escape.
Dense-flower counts concern an explicit configuration; no new global extremality, rotation-rank formula, high-rank additive-group cap or full-plane chromatic conclusion is asserted.
